resources.string: Download opens the link in a downloader or browser. Use “Send link” for apps that accept shared links. The file stays in that app, not in Peachy. When it is ready, Share the video to Peachy to add it to your library.
No app can open or receive this link. Install a downloader or browser and try again.
Optionally also save a copy in a folder. Copies are outside Peachy’s private library and are not protected by its PIN.
Cannot keep access to this folder. Choose another folder using the system picker.
Saved in Peachy, but one or more folder copies failed. Your library videos are safe. Check folder access and free space, or choose another folder.
